title: [p.apyr.us] Read the newspaper links go to /information, which 301s to a 404
description:
**Problem**
On https://p.apyr.us/ the "Read the newspaper" button, the "Newspaper" nav link and the FAQ/footer links all point at /information. That path 301-redirects to https://read.p.apyr.us/information, which returns 404. The newspaper itself is at https://read.p.apyr.us/. A visitor clicking the primary call to action lands on an error page.

**Evidence**
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' https://p.apyr.us/information` returns `301 https://read.p.apyr.us/information`
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://read.p.apyr.us/information` returns `404`
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://read.p.apyr.us/` returns `200`
- The live page is built from the Papyrus-web repo: content/index.md:10 (`[Read the newspaper](/information)`) and web/projector.py:37 and :126 (nav and footer `href="/information"`). The older public p.apyr.us repo has the same link in components/marketing/MarketingPage.tsx:41 and :55. The fix is tracked in Papyrus-web as a sibling issue.

**Fix**
Link to https://read.p.apyr.us/ instead of /information in content/index.md, web/projector.py and the FAQ text, or add a redirect that maps /information to the reader root. Rebuild and deploy.

**How to verify**
`curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://p.apyr.us/information` returns 200, and every "Read the newspaper" / "Newspaper" link on https://p.apyr.us/ resolves to a 200 page.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
